messages:
Tvek (ACME): Hi team — we received invoice INV-2025-045 but VAT was charged. We submitted a PO (PO-12345) and uploaded an exemption form for the parent entity (ACME Group Ltd). Can someone check?

Jordan (Support): Sorry about that. Can you paste the invoice PDF or a screenshot? Also which VAT ID did you submit?

Tvek (ACME): VAT ID is GB999999973. Uploaded here: https://files.acme.example/uploads/po-12345-exemption.pdf (link from customer portal). Invoice is billed to "ACME UK Services Ltd" (subsidiary).

Maria (Billing): Thanks @Tvek — I can see the upload. Looks like the uploaded exemption is for the parent entity name and VAT number, but our system matched billing_name=ACME UK Services Ltd when the invoice was created. That mismatch prevented the reverse-charge flag from applying.

Olvera (Finance): Do we have an internal policy for mapping parent VATs to subsidiaries? I thought we allowed parent-level exemptions when PO references parent.

Brian (Tax): We can allow it, but only if the invoice legal_entity field matches the VAT owner or there's an explicit intercompany declaration. We need either (1) billed name changed to ACME Group Ltd or (2) a signed reseller/intercompany declaration.

Jordan (Support): @Tvek can you confirm whether billing should be issued to the parent or the subsidiary? Customer says they submitted PO under parent but procurement routed billing to the subsidiary.

Tvek (ACME): Procurement asked for invoices to go to the operating entity (ACME UK Services Ltd) but tax wants reverse charge at group level. They asked us to attach the parent resale cert to the invoice so tax team can accept it.

Maria (Billing): OK — here's what I can do now: issue a credit for INV-2025-045 and reissue a corrected invoice to ACME Group Ltd (if we have authorization). I'll need an explicit authorization email from your procurement/tax team to re-bill the parent.

Tvek (ACME): I can get that. Also is there anything you need from Redwood to speed tax acceptance?

Brian (Tax): If you upload a signed intercompany form letting the parent cover VAT for the subsidiary, our billing system can set reverse_charge=true. The minimal required fields: parent_name, parent_vat, subsidiary_name, signed_date, PO_reference.

Samantha (Escalations): Looping in Legal for authorization template. @Ana can you drop a short one-line cover they can forward?

Ana (Legal): Sure — I'll paste a template they can attach: "We, ACME Group Ltd (VAT GB999999973), authorize Redwood Inference to reissue invoice INV-2025-045 in the name of ACME Group Ltd and apply EU reverse charge treatment to this supply. Signed: [name], Title, Date." They need to sign and upload.

billing-bot: Created credit note CN-2025-012 reversing INV-2025-045 (internal id 98765).

Maria (Billing): Note: system auto-checks VAT via VIES at invoice creation time. In this case VIES lookup for GB999999973 returned VALID, but our entity matching step prevented reverse charge. We'll need EngOps to tighten matching logic so a valid parent VAT can be used if PO references it.

EngOps: Luca: I reproduced the flow — when invoice is created via API with billing_name != vat_owner_name, the reverseCharge eligibility gate fails. Repro steps below.

EngOps: Luca: Repro steps:
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/invoices \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer redacted' \
  -d '{"billing_name":"ACME UK Services Ltd","po":"PO-12345","vat_id":"GB999999973","vat_owner_name":"ACME Group Ltd"}'
```
Response: 201 invoice created but reverse_charge=false and taxes.calculated=20.00
Logs: invoice_service:entity_matcher: mismatch on normalized_name -> fallback no_reverse_charge
```
TraceID: trc-0a1b2c3d
```

Jordan (Support): Thanks Luca. Can Eng make a one-time override so we can reissue without tax being charged once customer uploads the signed declaration?

EngOps: Luca: We can support a manual override from billing UI for escalations. @Maria can create the override ticket and include signed doc. I'll coordinate a safe path to flip reverse_charge for that invoice ID.

Maria (Billing): I'll wait for the signed authorization. Once uploaded I'll create internal override ticket INT-2345 and attach docs. We'll reissue invoice and mark original as credited. Expect a 24-48hr turnaround.

Tvek (ACME): I'll get procurement to sign and upload today. Any risk of tax penalties if we reissue to parent?

Brian (Tax): Low risk if the document shows explicit authorization and VAT ID matches VIES. Keep all records. If HMRC or local authority audits, this supports position.

Ana (Legal): One more note — redact personal emails from the signed doc and include corporate letterhead.

Tvek (ACME): Uploaded signed_declaration_acme_group_signed.pdf to the portal (link: https://files.acme.example/uploads/signed_declaration.pdf).

Maria (Billing): Got it. Creating override ticket now. INT-2345 created and assigned to EngOps. Attached doc.

billing-bot: Added note to invoice INV-2025-045: override_requested by Maria (Billing), ticket INT-2345.

EngOps: Luca: Performed manual override on invoice 98765, set reverse_charge=true and regenerated invoice as INV-2025-045-R with taxes = 0.00. Credit note CN-2025-012 applied to original.

Maria (Billing): Sent new invoice INV-2025-045-R to billing@acme.example and CCed procurement. Please confirm receipt.

Tvek (ACME): Received the updated invoice and VAT is 0. Thank you! :tada:

Jordan (Support): Closing the loop — marking this thread resolved. We'll create a small docs note for the billing KB describing the intercompany flow and required fields to avoid future mismatch.

Samantha (Escalations): Filing follow-up action: ENG-1248 (improve entity matching to accept parent VAT when PO references parent). Assigned to EngOps.

Brian (Tax): I'll add an internal tax checklist for these cases.

Ana (Legal): Leaving a template in #legal-templates channel.

Tvek (ACME): Thanks everyone, appreciate the fast turnaround!
